result.instructions: Tools for Semaphore CI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Why did the last pipeline on main fail? Show me the log of the failed job."; "Which of our self-hosted agents are running right now?"; "Show the deployment history of our production target for the last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Semaphore CI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run semaphore_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run semaphore_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run semaphore_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. semaphore_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: semaphore_get_pipeline
tools.title: Get a pipeline
tools.description: Get one pipeline: its state, result, branch, blocks and jobs. Set detailed=true only when you need full block and job detail (costly). GET /pipelines/{pipeline_id}.

pipeline_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

detailed.description: Include all blocks and jobs (default false).

tools.name: semaphore_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines for a project or a workflow, newest first, with filters by branch, creation and finish time. Give project_id or wf_id. GET /pipelines.

project_id.description: Project id (required unless wf_id is given).

wf_id.description: Workflow id (required unless project_id is given).

yml_file_path.description: Only pipelines from this YAML file.

next_page_url.description: next_page_url from the previous response. Pass it alone to get the next page; the other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: semaphore_list_plumber_workflows
tools.title: List workflows
tools.description: List workflows (runs started by a commit, branch or pull request) for a project. GET /plumber-workflows?project_id=.

project_id.description: Project id (required unless next_page_url is given).

next_page_url.description: next_page_url from the previous response. Pass it alone to get the next page; the other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: semaphore_get_plumber_workflow
tools.title: Get a workflow
tools.description: Get one workflow run by id: its commit, branch, trigger and pipeline list. GET /plumber-workflows/{workflow_id}.

workflow_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_list_promotions
tools.title: List promotions
tools.description: List the promotions (manual or automatic deployment steps) of one pipeline. GET /promotions?pipeline_id=.

pipeline_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job: its name, state, result, machine type and timing. GET /jobs/{job_id}.

job_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_get_job_logs
tools.title: Get job logs
tools.description: Get the log events of one job (command output, timestamps, exit codes). Use it to explain a failed job. GET /logs/{job_id}.

job_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List running agents (cloud and self-hosted), optionally for one agent type. Use the cursor from the response for the next page. GET /agents.

agent_type.description: Only agents of this agent type.

tools.name: semaphore_get_agent
tools.title: Get an agent
tools.description: Get one agent by name: its state, agent type, version and current job. GET /agents/{agent_name}.

tools.name: semaphore_list_self_hosted_agent_types
tools.title: List self-hosted agent types
tools.description: List the self-hosted agent types of the organization and their settings. GET /self_hosted_agent_types.

tools.name: semaphore_get_self_hosted_agent_type
tools.title: Get a self-hosted agent type
tools.description: Get one self-hosted agent type and its settings. GET /self_hosted_agent_types/{agent_type_name}.

tools.name: semaphore_list_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: List organization members: users by default, or service accounts or groups with member_type. Paginated. GET /members.

tools.name: semaphore_list_project_members
tools.title: List project members
tools.description: List the members and their project roles for one project. GET /projects/{project_id}/members.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the organization and project roles and the permissions each role grants. GET /roles.

tools.name: semaphore_get_role
tools.title: Get a role
tools.description: Get one role and its permissions. GET /roles/{role_id}.

role_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_list_permissions
tools.title: List permissions
tools.description: List the permissions available at organization or project scope. GET /permissions?scope=.

tools.name: semaphore_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups of the organization and their members. Paginated. GET /groups.

tools.name: semaphore_list_service_accounts
tools.title: List service accounts
tools.description: List the service accounts of the organization (names and state, never tokens). GET /service_accounts.

tools.name: semaphore_list_deployment_targets
tools.title: List deployment targets
tools.description: List the deployment targets of one project (for example production or staging). GET /deployment_targets?project_id=.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_get_deployment_target
tools.title: Get a deployment target
tools.description: Get one deployment target: its rules, active state and environment variable names. GET /deployment_targets/{target_id}.

target_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_get_deployment_target_history
tools.title: Get deployment history
tools.description: Get the deployment history of one target: who deployed what, from which git reference and when. Use the cursor fields to page. GET /deployment_targets/{target_id}/history.

target_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

cursor_type.description: Where to start: FIRST, AFTER or BEFORE.

cursor_value.description: Unix microsecond timestamp for AFTER or BEFORE.

git_ref_label.description: Filter by git reference label, e.g. a branch name.

triggered_by.description: Filter by the user who triggered the deployment.

tools.name: semaphore_get_pre_flight_checks
tools.title: Get pre-flight checks
tools.description: Get the pre-flight checks (setup commands run before each job) of a project, or of the organization when project_id is omitted. GET /pre_flight_checks.

project_id.description: Project id (omit for the organization setting).

tools.name: semaphore_list_artifacts
tools.title: List artifacts
tools.description: List the artifact files and folders under a project, workflow or job scope. Lists only; it returns no download link. GET /artifacts.

scope_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_list_flaky_tests
tools.title: List flaky tests
tools.description: List the flaky tests of a project: tests whose pass rate is below a threshold on a branch. GET /projects/{project_id}/test_results/flaky_tests.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

label.description: Comma-separated labels; tests must carry all of them.

tools.name: semaphore_get_flaky_test
tools.title: Get a flaky test
tools.description: Get one flaky test record: its pass rate and history. GET /projects/{project_id}/test_results/flaky_tests/{id}.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_get_performance_insights
tools.title: Get pipeline performance
tools.description: Get the run time of one pipeline file over time (per day or per range). GET /projects/{project_id}/insights/performance.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

pipeline_file.description: Pipeline YAML path in the repository, e.g. .semaphore/semaphore.yml.

tools.name: semaphore_get_reliability_insights
tools.title: Get pipeline reliability
tools.description: Get the pass rate of one pipeline file over time. Stopped pipelines are excluded. GET /projects/{project_id}/insights/reliability.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

pipeline_file.description: Pipeline YAML path in the repository, e.g. .semaphore/semaphore.yml.

tools.name: semaphore_get_frequency_insights
tools.title: Get pipeline frequency
tools.description: Get how often one pipeline file ran over time. GET /projects/{project_id}/insights/frequency.

project_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

pipeline_file.description: Pipeline YAML path in the repository, e.g. .semaphore/semaphore.yml.

tools.name: semaphore_partial_rebuild_pipeline
tools.title: Rebuild failed pipeline jobs
tools.description: Start a partial rebuild of a pipeline: only failed and blocked parts run again. It uses machine time. Reuse the same request_token to retry safely. POST /pipelines/{pipeline_id}/partial_rebuild.

pipeline_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

request_token.description: Idempotency token, typically a UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same request.

tools.name: semaphore_stop_job
tools.title: Stop a job
tools.description: Stop one running job. The job ends with a stopped result and cannot resume. POST /jobs/{job_id}/stop.

job_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

tools.name: semaphore_terminate_workflow
tools.title: Terminate a workflow
tools.description: Terminate one workflow run: all its pipelines stop. It cannot resume. POST /plumber-workflows/{workflow_id}/terminate.

workflow_id.description: The id (UUID or name) from another tool's output.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Semaphore CI
prompts.description: What you can do with Semaphore CI here, with example requests to try.
